final: WITH matched AS (SELECT ab.abhvreg, ab.translink, t.ordertypedist FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = ab.translink WHERE ab.peercorr > 0.149 AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL), combo AS (SELECT translink, ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM matched GROUP BY translink, ordertypedist) SELECT translink, ordertypedist, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS frac FROM combo ORDER BY frac DESC LIMIT 10
